text:
Maya: heads up — after the v9-compact canary we pushed at ~14:03 UTC we saw a p99 jump on several shards. p99 220ms -> ~1.4s, p95 up too. :eyes:
Alex: saw it on gpu-7 and gpu-11. overall throughput down ~30% for that canary slice.
Ravi: dropping profiler traces now, @Maya can you share the kernel selection logs + kv metrics for the affected requests?
Maya: pasting short dump — kernel chooser picks a fallback matmul in many cases, seq_len looks high for these requests:
```
[2026-03-17T14:04:12Z] request_id=rf-9a kernel_decider: model=v9-compact candidate_kernels=[matmul_trt_opt, matmul_trt_fallback, matmul_cpu] selected=matmul_trt_fallback reason="seq_len>512 AND quant_path_enabled" seq_len=912 kv_cache_hit=false
[2026-03-17T14:04:12Z] request_id=rf-9b kernel_decider: selected=matmul_trt_fallback seq_len=1024 kv_cache_hit=false
kv_cache_summary: shard=gpu-7 hit_rate=0.43 (baseline ~0.72)
```
Alex: interesting — fallback kernel has much higher per-token latency for long seqs in the quantized path.
Li: checked tokenizer stats for the canary input sets — seqlen distribution shifted hard right. median ~180 -> ~260, tail now ~800-1200 for ~2.3% of requests. Looks like token splitting changed.
Maya: the canary includes a tokenizer tweak from frontend to "preserve_whitespace=true" to avoid over-splitting URLs. that could explain long contiguous tokens.
Ravi: that aligns. long contiguous tokens -> larger effective seq lengths after BPE -> kernel_selector picks fallback which is slow under quantized kernels. Also kv cache misses because prefixes no longer match earlier cached prefixes.
Alex: also seeing a hotshard pattern: a few tenants are sending large docs with unbroken sequences. t-42 accounts for ~45% of the long-tail traffic during the window. noisy neighbor + kernel mismatch = p99 spike.
deploy-bot: canary deploy v9-compact (sha: d4c3b2) initiated by ci/CD at 2026-03-17T14:02:59Z.
Maya: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) roll back tokenizer tweak in canary, 2) route new requests for that model to the stable variant for 30m, 3) temporarily bias kernel selector to prefer matmul_trt_opt for seq_len < 1536 even on quant_path.
Ravi: also recommend bumping kv cache retention for prefixes for the canary slice to recover hit rate while we stabilize.
Li: I can add a short-circuit in the tokenization preprocessor to break long URL-like tokens into safe chunks as a faster rollback if we don't want full rollback.
Alex: infra can apply a region-level routing override. I'll open a route change and target us-west canary traffic to stable variant for 30m.
Maya: adding a small perf test (synthetic) that reproduces the tail so we can validate the kernel selector fix. snippet: ```python
x = random_long_docs(n=2000, url_preserve=True)
run_bench(model='v9-compact', inputs=x, measure=['p50','p95','p99'])
```
Ravi: pushed a quick patch to kernel decider to include seq_len_heuristic and prefer the optimized matmul for seq_len<1536. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rt/runtime/pull/1248 (wip).
deploy-bot: routing override applied by infra: route(v9-compact, canary) -> stable-variant for us-west at 2026-03-17T14:18:03Z.
Alex: after routing change p99 has dropped to ~260ms on the affected hosts, throughput back to ~95% baseline.
Jen: noted. I'll kick off a short postmortem template and schedule a follow-up to decide long-term fixes (tokenizer contract, kernel selector heuristics, kv caching behavior).
Maya: thanks all. action items: Ravi finalize kernel-selector PR, Li add tokenizer short-circuit patch, Alex keep routing for 30m and monitor. will update postmortem when we have root-cause writeup. :thumbsup:
